embeds.title: THE CUP CHANGES HANDS
embeds.description: 🏆 The BLHA Cup goes to **`[FRANCHISE]`**, Season `[YEAR]` champion.

fields.name: HANDED OFF
fields.value: `[IN PERSON / BY MAIL]` on `[DATE]`, from `[LAST SEASON'S CHAMPION / THE COMMISSIONER]`.

fields.name: THE TRADITION
fields.value: The champion keeps the Cup until the next BLHA Championship is decided, then passes it on. Every champion gets a Day with the Cup: send the Commissioner a photo or two and they're posted here.

fields.name: JUST FOR FUN
fields.value: The Cup is the trophy, not a prize: it carries no money and changes nothing in the standings or the draft.
